voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: On Christmas night, nineteen forty-five, a fire destroyed the Sodder family home in the West Virginia hills.
Five of the ten Sodder children were never seen again.
beats.cap:
FIVE OF TEN
NEVER SEEN AGAIN

beats.vo: No bones were found in the ashes. A coroner issued death certificates without remains.
Twenty-two years later, a photograph arrived in the mail. The family believed it showed their son Louis, in his twenties.
The billboard stood by the highway for forty years. No explanation was ever confirmed.
